purpose: Mechanical nightly package discovery input; scheduling and activation policy remain in the agency protocol.

activation.kernel: Stage changed kernels separately for a supervised reboot; do not withhold safe userspace updates.
activation.client: Require fresh home-presence proof immediately before automatic flash; away or unknown defers. Tailscale reachability alone is not home proof.

packages.updateMechanism: Refresh llm-agents, build and switch affected host configurations.
packages.activationNotes: Preserve running sessions; verify the normal command path for fresh launches.

packages.updateMechanism: Refresh llm-agents and rebuild the existing DSH wrapper/release.
packages.activationNotes: Keep accounts, writable user state and running instances; report package and each daemon instance release separately.

packages.updateMechanism: Resolve the upstream stable release and update the explicit input revision and lock together.
packages.activationNotes: Preserve the PTY-owning server and protocol compatibility. Package installation must not kill live sessions; report retained running server separately.

packages.updateMechanism: Compare latest stable upstream with the candidate; update an explicit package provider without refreshing the whole base/kernel pin.
packages.activationNotes: Existing shells continue; fresh shells use the updated package. Current base pin may prevent a plain nixpkgs-fresh refresh advancing fish.

packages.updateMechanism: Update the source recipe version, exact source hash, Go vendor hash and compatible toolchain; qualify existing patches and adapters.
packages.activationNotes: Input refresh alone does not update this recipe. Preserve running terminals and their retained helper packages; new terminals use the new package.

packages.updateMechanism: Refresh nixpkgs-fresh and verify the packaged stable Chrome version against upstream.
packages.activationNotes: Preserve the running browser and profile; new browser process adopts the update. Do not add Chrome to headless hosts.

packages.updateMechanism: Compare stable upstream and candidate versions; update an explicit package provider without broad base/kernel churn.
packages.activationNotes: Preserve active transport. Inspect actual tailscaled unit effects and report a specific unresolved blocker; do not silently omit this package.

packages.updateMechanism: Update the explicit Domicile revision and lock together, keeping SDK and prebuilt engine matched.
packages.activationNotes: Automatic flash is home-only. Preserve live desktop work; separately report installed and running compositor revisions.

packages.updateMechanism: Resolve stable upstream, update the relevant input pins and qualify the existing inference and embedding routes.
packages.activationNotes: Wait for actual idle/checkpoint proof. No model acquisition, pruning, worker resurrection or inference-configuration change is implied. Report incompatible releases as blocked.
